combo1.title: Blazing Dominion Bystial Six-Piece Endboard
combo1.description: A five-card Power Vice Dragon opener that chains through The Crimson King's search into Crimson Gaia for follow-up, builds the core Resonator recursion loop via Red Rising Dragon, then bridges through Crimson Blade Dragon into the Bystial suite. Resolves into Crimson Dragon Quetzalcoatl mass-reviving Bystial Dis Pater, The Crimson King, and Crimson Blade Dragon for a full six-monster board alongside Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss and Storm-Bane Dragon Destorbim, with Shining Star Dragon retained in hand as additional disruption.

steps.text: Send to GY Power Vice Dragon
Send to GY Red Rising Dragon
Add to Hand The Bystial Lubellion
Send to GY The Bystial Lubellion
Send to GY Crimson Blade Dragon
Send to GY The Crimson King
Synchro Summon Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss
Send to GY The Bystial Lubellion
Send to GY Bystial Dis Pater
Add to Hand Shining Star Dragon

combo2.title: Power Vice One-Card Quetzalcoatl Revival
combo2.description: A one-card Power Vice Dragon opener that asks only for a spare discard. Power Vice Dragon Special Summons itself and searches Soul Resonator, whose Normal Summon adds Bone Archfiend, while the resulting The Crimson King searches Darkness Resonator. Bone Archfiend mills Vision Resonator to bridge Crimson Gaia into Crimson Call for Synkron Resonator, then Crimson Blade Dragon adds The Bystial Lubellion as the Resonator recursion climbs through Bystial Dis Pater into Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss. Lubellion and Bystial Magnamhut recycle Darkness Resonator through banishment so Crimson Dragon Quetzalcoatl can mass-revive Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss, Crimson Blade Dragon and The Crimson King, closing on a six-monster board where Abyss, Bystial Dis Pater and Quetzalcoatl each hold an interruption.

steps.text: Send to GY Power Vice Dragon
Add to Hand The Bystial Lubellion
Send to GY The Crimson King
Send to GY Crimson Blade Dragon
Synchro Summon Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss
Send to GY The Bystial Lubellion
Send to GY Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss
Synchro Summon Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss
